title: De la Gardie campaign
summary: The English Wikipedia article "De la Gardie campaign", at revision 1370951523, opens: "The De la Gardie campaign was a joint military campaign by Russia and Sweden during the Polish–Russian War, which lasted from April 1609 to June 1610." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2022818, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1609 led by Jacob De la Gardie". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
